# American Timber Shade

> Premium Outdoor Spaces. Flagship timber pergolas and complete outdoor-living
> design-build — pavilions, outdoor kitchens, fire features, privacy screens,
> lighting, and spa surrounds — designed and built across the Mountain West.

## About

American Timber Shade builds shade structures like structures, not furniture:
posts on concrete footings below frost line, spans engineered for mountain
snow, through-bolted connections, and UV-stable finishes chosen for
high-altitude sun. The flagship is the timber pergola — attached,
freestanding, or heavy timber with pegged mortise-and-tenon joinery — and the
firm designs the whole outdoor space around it on one plan, built by one crew.
A Spravek company, alongside Alpine Fence & Deck, Utah Pergola Experts, Harlow
Landscapes, SPX Construction, Braddock Concrete, and Relentless Equipment.

- Region: Mountain West — Utah, Idaho, Colorado, Wyoming, Nevada, Arizona
- Headquarters: Wasatch Front, Utah
- Price tier: premium residential ($$$)

## Timber Pergolas (flagship)

- Attached pergolas — ledgered and through-bolted to the house
- Freestanding pergolas — braced and footed for open yards
- Heavy timber & mortise-and-tenon — 10×10 to 12×12 timbers, pegged joinery
- Western red cedar and Douglas fir, rough-sawn or resawn
- Options: shade canopies, motorized shade, privacy screens, integrated
  lighting, fans, heaters, outlets in posts, steel accents

## Outdoor Living

- Pavilions & solid roofs
- Outdoor kitchens
- Fire features (pits, tables, masonry fireplaces)
- Privacy screens & walls
- Lighting & electrical
- Hot tub & spa surrounds
- Complete outdoor-living design-build

## Frequently asked

### How do proposals work?
Call, text, or send the project form. We walk the yard, map the sun, and put
drawings, materials, and price in writing — options priced separately —
before any work starts.

### Will a timber pergola survive mountain snow?
Yes. Beams and rafters are sized to local snow load, posts sit on concrete
footings below frost line, and every connection is through-bolted. Stamped
engineering is included where required.

### Do you build outside Utah?
Yes. Headquartered on the Wasatch Front, crews travel across the Mountain
West — Idaho, Colorado, Wyoming, Nevada, and Arizona — for the right projects.
